title: The 1RB0LE sweepers with E1 = 0RE: an erased separator cell takes one unit of carry
text: In 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_0LC--- and its two E1 = 0RE siblings most defects of the chain are one erased cell in a separator. When a carry of c reaches one, the separator is restored and the carry goes on as c − 3. With this law the runs reach about 10<sup>927</sup> (0LC) and 10<sup>906</sup> (1LA) events with no halt. 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- reaches 10<sup>128</sup> events, where the event cell moves into the chain. The other kind of defect, a half-digit shift, is open.
